title: Isaac + Elden Ring Mashup
tagline: A local offline companion loop between Isaac and Elden Ring
description: A single-player mashup that connects The Binding of Isaac: Repentance to Elden Ring through a shared bridge log and offline companion launcher. Players own both Steam copies, and the project prepares the Isaac mod install and runs the bridge monitor before launching the games.

components.name: isaac_bridge_mod
components.description: Installs the Isaac side bridge mod into the player's Isaac mod folder.

components.name: bridge_monitor
components.description: Installs the Python monitor and config into a local app-data folder used by the launcher.

components.name: launch_script
components.description: Installs the Windows one-click launcher used to start the bridge monitor and launch both games.

launch.notes: Launches the bridge monitor and opens the Steam game installs after the required mod files are placed.

requirements: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance on Steam
ModEngine2 for Elden Ring offline mode with EAC disabled
credits: Games: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance and Elden Ring by their respective publishers
